text: ほんとうは　もう　わかって　おるのじゃが　なんどでも　たしかめたいんじゃ！

structure.jp: ほんとうは　もう　わかって　おるのじゃが
なんどでも　たしかめたいんじゃ！
structure.en: I want to check any number of times

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: おる is an old-man or dialect form of いる, so て＋おる is the same as 〜ている and says a state continues. わかっておる = 'I know'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the old-man form of だ; のじゃ gives an explaining tone and が means 'but'. おるのじゃが = 'I do know, but'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい after a verb stem says you want to do it. たしかめたいんじゃ = 'I want to check (you see)'.
